Results.ReviewText: We've always been Weber charcoal grillers until recently, when I can't handle the charcoal taste anymore (bad heartburn). So we bought a Spirit II. The grill is fabulous. My husband can still "char" the meat to his liking without me getting heartburn. He also says that he loves the ease of grilling with propane (and he was a die hard charcoal man)! My only complaint is that there is no easy way to move the grill. We got the Spirit II because  it was designed to be wheeled on the ground / grass. The problem is that there are no handles on the grill to move it and no comfortable way to grab onto some part of it in order to move it. Yes, the bigger wheels are great, but where on the grill is a person supposed to pick the unit up and lift it off the two stationary legs so that it can be wheeled?  Even if you put the collapsible tray down, there is no comfortable way to wheel the unit. If someone would have designed this grill to actually be movable, I would give it 5 stars.
Results.Title: Great grill but a pain to move

Results.ReviewText: Seems fairly durable.  I’m replacing a 20 year old Weber Genesis which was a solid workhorse.  This one isn’t as solid as the Genesis was...but I couldn’t really justify the Genesis cost.  My main complaint is that it is very hard to control the temperature.  Even with all three burners set to low, my grill temp is around 425 according to the thermometer in the lid.  Trying to do indirect cooking with middle burner off and two outside burners set to midway between medium and low, and the temp is still around 425. However, meat doesn’t appear to be cooking as quickly as I would guess it would at 425. Guess it’s time to get an instant read thermometer until I can figure out the settings better.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
